This script does not run a solver, decoder, analysis, build, Git, deletion, compression, scheduler registration, connectivity test, retry or future automatic rearm. The completed coarse watcher and all other existing watchers/helpers remain protected and must never be restarted or rearmed.
fixed_run: Tag upl_hg_mid2_CPU1_half_r1; exact Python owner D:/anaconda3/python.exe -u -B <absolute tests/support/upl_hg_mid2_half_r1.py> --action run --admission <actual absolute root-admission JSON> --execution-authorized; 2097152 steps at dt 2^-20 s, 2 s endpoint, 1517 native frames, CPU1. Prepared prefix outputs/upl_hg_mid2_half_seed_r1/upl_hg_mid2_half_r1 and output outputs/upl_hg_mid2_CPU1_half_r1. The owner must already be live. Root independently reads and pins the actual new half start bytes and SHA256 at launch; the watcher derives and freezes only that start actual PID, creation epoch, executable, full argv and cwd. No future owner PID, creation or incomplete adapter hash is guessed.
new_schemas: Require upl_hg_mid2_half_start_r1 / upl_hg_mid2_half_run_r1 / upl_hg_mid2_half_call_r1 and exact manifest/build/program/reader-helper/root-admission/job bindings. Require logs/upl_hg_mid2_half_r1.inputs.json stage upl_hg_mid2_half_prepare_r1 with jobs=[actual start.job], and logs/upl_hg_mid2_half_reader_ReleaseCPU_r1.helper.json stage upl_hg_mid2_half_reader_build_r1 bound to that manifest and source build. The direct Python call uses typed_returncode_captured_immediately, not PowerShell LASTEXITCODE. A successful run must retain actual integer exit zero, threads=1, steps=2097152, native_frames=1517, unchanged input bindings and original HG counters: forcecalls/ratecalls=4194304, predictorupdates/correctorupdates=2097152, ratecalculations=2097153, ratecachehits=2097151. Failure receipts may have no completed call; they remain failure notifications rather than invented completion.
immutable_evidence: Freeze the actual half start and every start input, this new watcher/note, interpreter, psutil and the retained-base root-inspected explicit Codex executable. The owner script is verified from the actual start Entry and required input closure; no authoring-time partial script hash is invented. Full hash at launch, worker startup and terminal; polls check only size and mtime_ns against startup metadata. This is a low-I/O performance choice, not a continuous-hash or atomic-race proof. Rehash every consumed immutable and terminal raw native solver file before sealing the terminal report. Native file hashes and membership are identity checks, never decoded field, true clock or physical acceptance.
polling: Poll every 30 seconds. A stable exact final run receipt is terminal whether passed or failed. A call or process exit alone is never completion. PID reuse or command/cwd/executable change is an explicit failure; AccessDenied is unobservable, not exit. Observe a dead owner without a valid final run for over 120 seconds before notifying that failure. Binding changes generate terminal expected-versus-actual observations and a single failure notification, never a blind rerun.
queue_contract: Use exactly [codex, queue, --thread, 01a07683-bc64-7463-8db7-9ee6243967d8, --message, message]. Seal terminal plus an exclusive queue_attempt containing full evidence before that sole subprocess call. Timeout 45 seconds, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, capture return code/output. A timeout may already have delivered and is recorded uncertain; never resend. Fresh lock/status/worker log/terminal/attempt/result or temporary status blocks another launch. Only this identified worker may atomically update its status.
continuation: Ask root to inspect actual ownership, all expected and observed hashes, run/call/input/source/build/program/native identities, and current independent job state. Failed or incomplete evidence is reviewed offline, never blindly repeated. A successful solver run still needs separate native review: inspect existing or active half reader/native ownership and artifacts before one legitimate authorized half decode. Preserve this half own 1517 samples, 1040 IDs, 22 arrays, true dyadic clocks, ledger, original HG guards and drainage. Verify active drain receivers per history row: zero through completed step 10486, ten afterward, 1313 post-open frames and 13130 checks. Inspect a fresh pair review before analysis to avoid duplication. Across all 1517 coarse/half frames require actual time alignment <=1e-14 s, pore-pressure RMS <=5 Pa and maximum material-ID XYZ displacement difference <=0.005 mm; also compare fixed initial material top/bottom settlement, total stress and alternating X-column Uz. Compare this CPU1 half own first 1469 frames to CPU8 half without fabricating CPU1 bits from CPU8. This watcher invents no future decoder receipt schema or decoder command.
limits: Independent 2 s coarse/half pairing is no theory, full consolidation, late-mode cure or formal physical acceptance. Do not infer public 3D or observer/feedback initialization acceptance from the separate GPU Release component pass. Protect formal results, raw BI4/NBI4, source/program archives and all independent active dependencies. Report quantitative results in Chinese and continue already authorized work without a new user prompt; no automatic formal/full expansion, no old coarse watcher restart/rearm.
